products.title: BLUSH HOUR
products.subtitle: Italian Mandarin & Red Berries · White Gardenia & Frangipani · Brown Sugar Accord
products.description: Blush Hour captures that fleeting moment when everything feels softer, brighter and impossibly beautiful. It begins with a sparkling, fruity freshness before revealing a lush floral heart that feels graceful and effortlessly feminine. As it settles, a warm sweetness appears beneath the florals, creating a soft yet addictive trail that stays memorable without becoming overpowering. It is elegant, youthful and radiant—the kind of fragrance that doesn't demand attention, but naturally receives it.
products.scentFamily: Sparkling Fruity Floral & Warm Brown Sugar
products.usageRitual: Spray 2-3 times on pulse points (wrists, collarbone, behind ears) immediately after a warm shower for all-day radiant projection.
products.shortDescription: Italian Mandarin, Red Berries, Blossom Accord. White Gardenia, Jasmine Absolute, Frangipani Flower. Patchouli, Brown Sugar Accord

products.title: VANILLA COVENANT
products.subtitle: Creamy, Warm, Sweet Gourmand · Vanilla-Led Accord · Deep Personal Character
products.description: Vanilla Covenant is built around the feeling of something familiar, warm and deeply personal. Its creamy sweetness creates an immediate sense of comfort, while the smooth development of vanilla gives the fragrance an intimate, enveloping character. Rather than being an ordinary sweet fragrance, it carries a refined warmth that feels close to the skin and becomes more captivating with time. It is made for memories that are quiet, personal and impossible to replace.
products.scentFamily: Warm Creamy Gourmand Vanilla
products.usageRitual: Mist gently on neck, wrists, and clothing for an intimate, comforting warmth that unfolds gorgeously as body heat rises.
products.shortDescription: Creamy, Warm, Sweet, Gourmand. Vanilla-led creamy accord. Soft, Warm, Long-lasting Vanilla Character

products.title: THE ECLIPSE
products.subtitle: Clary Sage, Bergamot & Rosemary · Egyptian Jasmine & Marine · Amber, Ambergris & Minerals
products.description: The Eclipse is built around contrast—the meeting of crisp light, open air and mysterious depth. It begins with an aromatic freshness created by clary sage, Italian bergamot and Moroccan rosemary, then gradually reveals a fascinating heart where Egyptian jasmine meets marine freshness and earthy patchouli. The final stage becomes warmer and more mysterious through amber, ambergris and mineral facets, leaving an atmospheric trail that feels sophisticated and different from the ordinary. It is a fragrance for those who prefer to leave an impression rather than an explanation.
products.scentFamily: Aromatic Marine, Crisp Herbal & Mineral Amber
products.usageRitual: Spray 3-4 times along jawline, cuffs, and chest for commanding, atmospheric sillage that stays fresh all day.
products.shortDescription: Clary Sage, Italian Bergamot, Moroccan Rosemary. Egyptian Jasmine, Marine Notes, Patchouli. Amber, Ambergris, Mineral Notes

products.title: GOLDEN BAKERY
products.subtitle: Banana Leaves, Geranium & Caramel · Sugar & Rose · Musk, Vanilla & Cocoa Butter
products.description: Golden Bakery transforms the feeling of warmth and familiarity into a fragrance. Its opening creates an unusual contrast between fresh green banana leaf, geranium and caramel before moving into a softer heart of sugar, rose and vanilla. The dry-down becomes creamy and comforting with musk, vanilla and cocoa butter, leaving behind a smooth sweetness that feels nostalgic without becoming childish. It is the fragrance equivalent of returning to a place that instantly feels like home.
products.scentFamily: Nostalgic Green Gourmand & Creamy Cocoa
products.usageRitual: Mist over inner wrists and neck for an addictive, comforting hug in scent form.
products.shortDescription: Banana Leaves, Geranium, Caramel. Sugar, Rose, Vanilla. Musk, Vanilla, Cocoa Butter

products.title: AFTER MIDNIGHT
products.subtitle: Almond, Coffee & Citrus · Tuberose, Jasmine & Bulgarian Rose · Tonka Bean, Praline & Amber
products.description: After Midnight captures the transformation that happens when the world becomes quieter and confidence takes over. Its opening combines almond, coffee, bergamot and lemon to create a bright yet addictive first impression. A rich floral heart of tuberose, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, orris and Bulgarian rose follows, before revealing an exceptionally warm and indulgent foundation of tonka bean, cacao, vanilla, praline, woods, musk, amber and spice. Bold, sensual and unforgettable, it is designed for nights that are never meant to feel ordinary.
products.scentFamily: Sensual Oriental Gourmand, White Florals & Woods
products.usageRitual: Mist across pulse points and hair before an evening out. Projection intensifies with body warmth.
products.shortDescription: Almond, Coffee, Bergamot, Lemon. Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Orange Blossom, Orris, Bulgarian Rose. Tonka Bean, Cacao, Vanilla, Praline, Sandalwood, Musk, Amber, Cashmere Wood, Cinnamon, Patchouli, Cedar

products.title: ROSE MAUDITE
products.subtitle: Fresh Rose Petals & Cardamom · Rose Absolute & Jasmine · Warm Musk, Amber & Sandalwood
products.description: Rose Maudite is a celebration of rose through the atmosphere of a memorable gathering. It opens with fresh rose petals lifted by citrus, cardamom and pink pepper, creating a lively and softly spiced introduction. The heart becomes richer with rose absolute, geranium and jasmine, while warm musk, amber and creamy sandalwood create a graceful trail that lingers after the moment has passed. Elegant without being loud, Rose Maudite carries the warmth of conversations, celebrations and memories shared with people who matter.
products.scentFamily: Spiced Floral Rose & Warm Creamy Sandalwood
products.usageRitual: Spray on collarbone and wrists. The opening blooms gracefully into creamy sandalwood and warm amber.
products.shortDescription: Fresh Rose Petals, Citrus, Cardamom, Pink Pepper. Rose Absolute, Geranium, Jasmine. Warm Musk, Amber, Creamy Sandalwood

products.title: THE NINTH TIDE
products.subtitle: Pineapple Sorbet & Mandarin · Salty Lavender & Bay Leaf · Earthy Vetiver & Patchouli
products.description: The Ninth Tide is a fragrance built around movement, freshness and the instinct to go beyond what is familiar. It opens with the energetic combination of pineapple sorbet, mandarin and bay leaf, creating a crisp and invigorating first impression. Clary sage, geranium and salty lavender then bring an airy, almost oceanic freshness before vetiver and patchouli ground the fragrance with earthy depth. Clean, energetic and distinctive, The Ninth Tide feels like the moment you leave the shore behind and move toward something unknown.
products.scentFamily: Energetic Oceanic Fruit & Earthy Woods
products.usageRitual: Spray on neck, chest, and arms. Refreshing burst in tropical humidity that lingers with rich vetiver.
products.shortDescription: Pineapple Sorbet, Mandarin, Bay Leaf. Clary Sage, Geranium, Salty Lavender. Vetiver, Patchouli

products.description:
A little flame. A beautiful surprise.

Whispered Surprises is a unique candle created to make every moment feel special. Inspired by soft florals, sweet fruity notes and a warm, comforting atmosphere, this candle fills your space with a beautiful fragrance.

products.title: NOOR OUD
products.sillage: Warm, Noticeable & Close to the Skin
products.subtitle: For those who prefer to smell different · Smooth, Deep Oud with Warm Smoky Character
products.description:
A smooth, deep Oud-led attar with a warm smoky character. The Oud gives it its distinctive depth, while subtle tobacco, spice and woody accords make it easier to wear and more balanced.

It is not overly sweet, not overly fresh, and not made to smell ordinary. The character stays close to the skin, creating a warm and noticeable scent without feeling excessive.

What makes it different:
A fragrance built around Oud rather than sweetness—giving you a more mature, refined and distinctive way to wear fragrance.

For:
Those who want a signature scent with character, especially for evenings, occasions, or everyday wear when you want something a little different.

Profile:
Oud-led • Woody • Smoky • Warm • Spiced

The idea:
Wear Oud. Keep your own character.
products.scentFamily: Oud-led • Woody • Smoky • Warm • Spiced
products.usageRitual: Apply a drop with the crystal applicator rod to pulse points (wrist, neck, collarbone). Gently dab—do not rub—to allow the smoky oud character to bloom naturally.
products.shortDescription: Oud-led • Woody • Smoky • Warm • Spiced. A fragrance built around Oud rather than sweetness.

products.title: KHWAAB
products.subtitle: The Essence · A Modern Expression of Oud for Everyday Moments
products.description:
A modern expression of Oud, created for everyday moments that deserve to feel special.

KHWAAB brings together the depth of Oud with a soft warmth and clean aromatic character. It feels rich without being too heavy, distinctive without being difficult to wear.

It is the kind of fragrance that can become your own smell—something familiar to you, yet different enough for people around you to notice.

Characteristics:
Oud-led • Warm • Woody • Smooth • Aromatic • Refined
The Oud gives KHWAAB its depth and individuality, while the surrounding warmth keeps it balanced and approachable.

The Impression:
KHWAAB is about leaving a good impression without trying too hard. You wear it to work, while meeting someone, going out in the evening, or simply when you want to feel well put together. It doesn’t need a special occasion. It makes an ordinary moment feel a little more like yours.

What Makes KHWAAB Different:
Many fragrances are made to immediately grab attention. KHWAAB is made to stay in memory. Its Oud character gives it something recognisable and different, while the smoother side makes it easy to wear again and again.

For someone who wants:
• A distinctive everyday fragrance
• The depth of Oud without it feeling overwhelming
• Something mature yet easy to wear
• A scent that works across different occasions
• A fragrance that can become their signature

When to Wear:
Day • Evening • Work • Gatherings • Special occasions
KHWAAB is intentionally versatile—one attar you don’t have to keep for only one type of occasion.

The Feeling:
”Something you wear for yourself, and others remember you by.”

KHWAAB — Oud with a feeling of its own.
products.scentFamily: Oud-led • Warm • Woody • Smooth • Aromatic • Refined
products.usageRitual: Dab directly onto pulse points before work, gatherings, or evenings. Transforms into an intimate, distinctive personal scent aura.
products.shortDescription: Oud-led • Warm • Woody • Smooth • Aromatic • Refined. Something you wear for yourself, and others remember you by.

RUH KHUS — Fresh from the earth. Made for you.

products.shortDescription: Earthy • Green • Cool • Woody • Fresh • Natural. Pure essential-oil-based attar without alcohol.

products.title: MUSK ROYAL
products.subtitle: Soft on the skin. Easy to remember. · Pure Comforting Musk with Soft Fruity Opening
products.description:
The Essence:
A smooth, alcohol-free Musk attar with a soft fruity opening and a warm, subtly sweet character. The Musk remains at the heart of the fragrance, giving it a clean and comforting feel.

Characteristics:
Soft • Clean • Warm • Musky • Subtly Sweet • Elegant

The Impression:
Musk Royal is made for people who want to smell naturally pleasant without being overpowering. It feels smooth and inviting, making it easy to wear whether you’re heading to work, meeting someone, or simply going about your day.

The gentle sweetness adds warmth, while the Musk gives it a familiar, skin-like quality that makes the fragrance feel personal rather than excessive.

Why You’ll Choose It:
If you prefer fragrances that are easy to like, easy to wear and still have their own character, Musk Royal fits naturally into your collection.

For:
Everyday wear • Work • Gatherings • Dates • Evenings • Special occasions

Pure & Alcohol-Free:
A pure essential-oil-based attar, without alcohol, created for direct, traditional fragrance wear.

MUSK ROYAL — Soft on the skin. Easy to remember.
products.scentFamily: Soft • Clean • Warm • Musky • Subtly Sweet • Elegant
products.usageRitual: Apply directly to collarbones and pulse points. Blends with your natural skin chemistry to create an effortless, inviting scent trail.
products.shortDescription: Soft • Clean • Warm • Musky • Subtly Sweet • Elegant. Skin-like quality that makes fragrance feel personal.

products.title: MIZAAJ
products.subtitle: Your kind of different · Rich Warm Coffee, Creamy Cacao, Golden Caramel & Bourbon Vanilla
products.description:
Your kind of different

The Essence:
A rich, alcohol-free oil attar where warm coffee and spice meet creamy cacao, caramel and vanilla. It starts warm and inviting, then becomes softer, sweeter and more addictive on the skin. The result is a gourmand fragrance that feels comforting, modern and different from a typical sweet attar.

Characteristics:
Gourmand • Creamy • Warm • Cacao-rich • Spiced • Smooth • Addictive

The Impression:
MIZAaj is for the person who wants their fragrance to feel approachable but memorable. It has the warmth of something familiar—like coffee, chocolate and freshly made sweets—but is blended into a fragrance rather than simply smelling like dessert. Sweet enough to be enjoyable. Rich enough to have character.

What Makes It Different:
This isn’t simply “a chocolate fragrance.” The coffee-spice warmth gives the cacao depth, while the creamy vanilla and caramel side make it smooth and easy to wear. That balance makes it work for someone who normally wears woody/oud fragrances as well as someone who prefers sweet, modern fragrances.

For You:
For the customer who wants:
• Something different.
• Something easy to love.
• Something people remember.
Wear it when you want your fragrance to feel a little more personal, playful and contemporary.

The Gen-Z Side:
Coffee energy. Chocolate comfort. Your own vibe. Not overly formal. Not old-fashioned. Just a fragrance that fits your mood, your outfit and your moment.

When to Wear:
Evenings • Dates • Cafés • Gatherings • Winter • Casual nights • Special moments

Oil Attar:
Alcohol-free • Oil-based • Skin-friendly fragrance format
products.scentFamily: Gourmand • Creamy • Warm • Cacao-rich • Spiced • Smooth • Addictive
products.usageRitual: Dab on pulse points before café dates, evenings, and casual nights. Radiates an intoxicating, addictive chocolate and coffee warmth.
products.shortDescription: Gourmand • Creamy • Warm • Cacao-rich • Spiced • Smooth • Addictive. Coffee energy. Chocolate comfort. Your own vibe.

products.title: GUL MEHFIL
products.subtitle: Some roses bloom. Some stay in memory · Fresh Blooming Living Rose with Gentle Warmth
products.description:
Some roses bloom. Some stay in memory.

The Essence:
A living rose, made for unforgettable presence.
GUL MEHFIL captures the feeling of walking into a gathering where everything feels warm, fresh and alive. The rose feels natural and blooming, while a gentle warmth underneath gives it depth instead of making it smell like a conventional rose perfume. It is soft enough to feel intimate, yet distinctive enough to become your signature.

What Makes GUL MEHFIL Different:
Most rose attars focus on making you smell like rose.
GUL MEHFIL focuses on what the rose does to your presence.
It creates an aura that feels fresh when first noticed, graceful as it settles, and warmly memorable on skin. That makes the fragrance less about a particular age, gender or occasion—and more about the impression you leave behind.

Characteristics:
Fresh • Rosy • Natural • Warm • Soft-Spiced • Elegant • Memorable

Overall Impression:
A fresh blooming rose with a warm, intimate character.
Not overly sweet.
Not too sharp.
Not an old-fashioned rose scent.
It feels clean, graceful and naturally attractive, with enough depth to stay interesting throughout the day.

For Her:
For girls who want their fragrance to feel feminine without being overly sweet or loud. Soft, graceful and effortlessly attractive—something that feels beautiful when you’re close to someone rather than filling the entire room.

For Him:
For men who prefer clean floral sophistication with warmth, rather than the usual heavy oud or musky attars. The rose gives it individuality without making it feel traditionally feminine.

For Everyone:
First meetings. Everyday wear. Work. Gatherings. Dates. Family occasions. Evenings.
Basically, the fragrance you reach for when you want people to remember how good you smelled, without wondering what you were trying to prove.

The Feeling:
“I don’t want everyone to notice my perfume. I want the right people to remember it.”
products.scentFamily: Fresh • Rosy • Natural • Warm • Soft-Spiced • Elegant • Memorable
products.usageRitual: Touch with glass applicator to wrists and collarbones. Creates a warm, natural rose presence that draws people in close.
products.shortDescription: Fresh • Rosy • Natural • Warm • Soft-Spiced • Elegant • Memorable. A fresh blooming rose with an intimate character.
